title: Semio OS Hub Plugin Module Store

PluginModuleStoreV1.description: The one persisted local-only store of hub-installed plugin modules: a Cache Storage cache whose entries are addressed under storeRoot, served to the page and its workers under serveRoute by the store's service worker.

HubProgramIdV1.description: The program a hub document runs on: the plugin id and the SHA-256 of the catalog generation's module bundle, joined by programSeparator. It never names a locally staged program, so a device runs a hub document on the hub's version beside its own.

PluginModuleSourceV1.description: Where a hub program's verified bytes came from: store (this device already holds the generation's bundle complete), local (every file of the bundle is byte-identical in this device's staged module), hub (installed from the hub).

PluginModuleStoreRecordV1.description: One installed plugin module of one catalog generation, written last, after its manifest and every file, so a record always names a complete bundle.
